--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,44 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Input must be numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrix")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Input must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError("Input must be finite")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError("Input must be nonpositive")
+    shape = logp_with_result.shape
+    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
+        raise ValueError("All inputs must have same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute total log-likelihoods over horizon
+    sum_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)
+    sum_call = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)
+    sum_no = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)
+
+    # Compute improvement: logp_with_result - max(logp_call_only, logp_no_call)
+    improvement = sum_with - np.maximum(sum_call, sum_no)
+
+    # Keep mask: improvement > tau_filter (strict inequality)
+    keep = improvement > tau_filter
+
+    # Return improvement as the finite margin
+    margin = improvement
+
+    # Ensure output types
+    keep = keep.astype(np.bool_)
+    margin = margin.astype(np.float64)
+
+    return (keep, margin)
